Enjoy this classic romantic Hindi song 'Saaz-E-Dil Chhed De' from the highest grossing film of 1961 'Passport' sung by Mohammed Rafi & Lata Mangeshkar. Music composed by Kalyanji Anandji. The film stars Pradeep Kumar, Madhubala, Mehmood, Helen, Mumtaz Begum. Directed by Pramod Chakravorty.
Singers: Mohammed Rafi & Lata Mangeshkar.
Music : Kalyanji Anandji

Directed by Pramod Chakravorty
